A1.justification: Both PDFs describe the same NeuroLM study. Their main text, equations, figures, tables, and appendices A-H are available and support a reliable comparison.

before.justification: v1 reports original six-dataset evaluations, training curves, ablations, and attention and embedding analyses, including appendix results.

after.justification: v2 retains the original evaluations and appendix analyses and adds a qualitative description of performance without embedding alignment.

M1.justification: The tokenizer, adversarial EEG-text alignment, multi-channel autoregressive pre-training, GPT-2 variants, and instruction-tuning procedure remain unchanged. Newly specified text sampling and expanded likelihood notation do not establish a changed algorithm.

E1.justification: Both versions use the same pre-training corpus and six downstream datasets: TUAB, TUEV, SEED, HMC, Workload, and TUSL. Table 6's additional citations identify the existing self-collected corpus; they do not add data coverage.

E2.justification: The same seven baselines remain in Tables 2-4, and the instruction-data-size comparison retains its comparator set. LaBraM is relabeled LaBraM-Base in Tables 2-4 with identical scores, without evidence of a comparator replacement.

E3.justification: Section 3.1 changes the stated HMC test subjects from 126-154 to 127-154, while validation remains 101-126. This removes the documented overlap; the PDFs do not establish that experiments were rerun. Other evaluation settings remain unchanged.

E4.justification: Appendix F.2 expands the existing alignment analysis by reporting near-zero downstream metrics without alignment, beyond v1's description of random-word answers. No new ablation condition is introduced, and the remaining robustness, reconstruction, attention, and pre-training analyses are retained.

E5.justification: Both versions report averages and standard deviations over three random seeds in Section 3.2. Uncertainty reporting in the result tables and figures is unchanged; no new statistical procedures are introduced.

E6.justification: Numerical results in Tables 2-4 and 10-12 and the plotted results are unchanged. Appendix F.2 newly states that omitting alignment produces near-zero scores across most downstream metrics, without providing additional per-task measurements.

T1.justification: Equation 7 replaces the whole-sequence conditional log-likelihood with an explicit sum over time steps 2 through T conditioned on past inputs, and defines the all-channel latent variables at each step. This refines the formal connection to autoregressive training. Equation 5's index edits also introduce an n/t inconsistency; no new theorem or proof is added.

C1.justification: The abstract, introduction, contribution statements, and conclusion retain the same claims about unified multi-task EEG processing, text-aligned tokenization, autoregressive pre-training, and instruction tuning. The six-task scope and model-scale claims are unchanged.

C2.justification: Section 3.3 replaces specific BIOT/TUEV and TUSL ranking commentary with potential generalization to novel tasks or prompts. Appendix F.2 newly proposes disordered attention from separated embedding spaces as an explanation for alignment failure. Appendix H's limitations remain unchanged.

D1.justification: Section 3.2 newly specifies random sampling of GPT-2 vocabulary embeddings for alignment. Table 7 identifies the existing 512 batch size as EEG and adds a text batch size of 128. v2 also supplies a repository pointer and source citations for the existing self-collected corpus.

R1.justification: Five works are added to document the self-collected corpus: Jiang et al. (2021, 2023), Luo et al. (2022), Li et al. (2021), and Tao and Lu (2020). The related-work discussion and positioning against EEG foundation models and multimodal LLMs otherwise remain unchanged.

P1.justification: Changes are localized to mathematical exposition, experimental details, the results discussion, and Appendix F.2. The header changes from Preprint to ICLR 2025 publication status. Section and appendix organization remain intact, without extensive rewriting.

P2.justification: Figure 1 is resized, its LaBraM series changes color, and its caption is shortened, while plotted values remain identical. Table 7 gains a text-batch row, Table 6's citation cell expands, and Table 12 moves from page 21 to page 22. No figure or result table is added or removed.

improvement.justification: v2 improves reproducibility information through explicit text sampling and batch sizes, corpus provenance, and a repository pointer, and corrects the overlapping HMC split description. These modest gains outweigh the small index inconsistency introduced in Equation 5. The empirical evidence remains essentially unchanged, and the new generalization and mechanism interpretations lack additional tests.
